definitions.explanation: The trouble or effort one takes on behalf of others or for a purpose; laborious work that requires significant effort.

examples.japanese: {骨折|ほねお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{報|むく}われた。
ご{骨折|ほねお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}します→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
{骨折|ほねお}り{損|ぞん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧くたびれ{儲|もう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: I pray it won't be effort wasted.

notes:
{骨折|ほねお}り means taking trouble or making an effort.

FORMS:
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ (bone) + {折|お}り (breaking, from ⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧)
- Literally: bone-breaking (work)
⟦{骨|ほね}を{折|お}る→骨を折る：17002_honewooru⟧: to take pains, to make an effort

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧ (bone fracture - medical term). The reading determines the meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {骨折|ほねお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{報|むく}われる: hard work pays off
- ご{骨折|ほねお}り: your trouble (polite)
- {骨折|ほねお}り{損|ぞん}: wasted effort

PROVERB:
{骨折|ほねお}り{損|ぞん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧くたびれ{儲|もう}け
Literally: "loss from bone-breaking effort, profit of tiredness"
Meaning: All that work for nothing; effort that yields no reward
